heating_cooling: Heat is the main threat. Plan shade, airflow and water; rest midday; know cooling centers; watch for heat illness.

risks: Leptospirosis: avoid wading or swimming in streams and ponds, especially with cuts; boil or treat any stream water (Hawaii DOH).
Rat lungworm: rinse every leaf of raw produce under running safe water, or freeze 24 hours or cook it; never eat raw snails or slugs (Hawaii DOH).
Island water systems can be cut off by storms; store water.
water.drinking_water_program: Search 'Hawaii drinking water program' or ask your water utility; private well guidance: https://www.epa.gov/privatewells

note: Island supply chains depend on shipping; stock up early.
